title: Progmasoft C/C++ Styles guidelines index
description: The index.json of a guidelines folder in Progmasoft C/C++ Styles (https://github.com/Progmasoft/progmasoft-cpp): the language versions it covers and every document with its chapter and the versions it applies to.

title.description: The name of the guidelines, such as "Progmasoft Core C++ Coding Guidelines".

license.description: The SPDX license identifier of the text of the guidelines.

standards.description: The language versions the guidelines cover. Exactly one is the default.

id.description: A lowercase identifier: letters, digits and hyphens.

path.description: A Markdown file, relative to the folder of index.json, with forward slashes.

id.description: The identifier documents use in their standards list, such as "cpp20".

name.description: The name of the version, such as "C++20".

default.description: Whether a project uses this version unless it says otherwise.

for.description: The projects this version is meant for.

documents.description: The documents that hold the rules of this version alone.

id.description: The identifier of the document, unique in the index.

chapter.description: The chapter number of a document shared by every version; a version's own page has none.

standards.description: The identifiers of the versions the document applies to.
